rationale.conceptual: The method builds on classical heterogeneous nucleation theory (Fletcher 1958) and the Turnbull empirical correlation; while the equations are explicit, the calculation requires non-trivial handling of surface energies, contact parameters, and nucleation probability curves, characteristic of an established but moderately complex domain-specific method.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of 3–4 sequential steps: compute surface energies, compute upper limits, and generate two CSV probability tables, all using standard Python libraries with straightforward I/O, without complex tooling or data fetches.
